lines.text: In the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, Nehemiah gave the king his wine, and the king asked why his face was sad.
Nehemiah said the city where his fathers were buried lay in ruins, with its gates destroyed by fire, and then he prayed to the God of heaven.
Nehemiah asked the king to send him to Judah to rebuild the city, and the king, with the queen beside him, asked how long the journey would take.
Nehemiah asked for letters to the governors west of the Jordan and to Asaph, keeper of the king's forest, for timber.
The king sent army officers and cavalry with Nehemiah, and Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Moabite official were deeply disturbed.
